items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: He used to play in a brass band with Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: Yeah, he had got shot in the neck one time. They would call him shot. Him and Howard and Sheik, Chris Kelly taught it them. But Sheik never had come out nowhere with them fellas. They all come out top trumpet players. And he just gave up, went out, and nearly Hawkins is his right name, or we called him Shotneck. He just went out and gave it up, you know, and after the time he got shot, standing looking at the parade. We used to have a lot of night parades.
